VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 independently reviewed HEAD c463a004345d0ff9a6a34a767929c8197c131558 against base 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc, reading the complete diff and touched files: AC-2 NOT SATISFIED overall (canonical result satisfied at src/math.mjs:72 and test/math.test.mjs:86; validation not satisfied at src/math.mjs:69; nonmutation satisfied at src/math.mjs:71-74); R-1 NOT SATISFIED at src/math.mjs:69-70 (finite-element and empty-array checks work, shape validation does not); R-2 SATISFIED at src/math.mjs:71-74 by read-only iteration and frozen-input probe; R-3 SATISFIED by complete diff preserving existing src/math.mjs:1-66 and test/math.test.mjs:5-83, with only the permitted existing import change at test/math.test.mjs:3; R-4 SATISFIED by unchanged package.json:1-10 and no dependency or generated-file changes in the complete two-file diff; R-5 SATISFIED at test/math.test.mjs:85 and :88, both new test names starting with max.

Finding F1 — MEDIUM, src/math.mjs:69-70 and test/math.test.mjs:88-89: max checks numeric length instead of Array.isArray, accepting a Float64Array and throwing RangeError for an empty typed array, empty string, or {length:0}, contrary to the required TypeError for non-array shapes; the added typed-array test explicitly enforces that forbidden behavior and the new tests omit rejection and nonmutation cases; this violates the shared public input contract despite green max tests; smallest verification after repair is to assert TypeError for those four non-array cases, retain RangeError for [], verify invalid finite-number elements and frozen-array nonmutation, and rerun the max tests.

Checks actually run: git rev-parse HEAD matched the candidate; node --test --test-name-pattern="^max" test/ exited 0 with "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing (unchanged known defect, not a finding); an initial supplemental heredoc probe could not start because the read-only sandbox refused its temporary file, then the same probe ran without files via node --input-type=module -e and exited 1 with "PASS: canonical result, frozen input, empty-array and invalid-element validation", "FAIL: typed array: expected TypeError, returned 9", "FAIL: empty typed array: expected TypeError, threw RangeError", "FAIL: empty string: expected TypeError, threw RangeError", and "FAIL: empty array-like object: expected TypeError, threw RangeError"; no files were changed, no withheld narrative was read, original implementer path ownership is not determinable from the reviewer-only brief, and repair of F1 remains before acceptance.
